messages:
clara: quick ping — onboarding weights for pubmodel/zeta-2.0. Mirror job failed on a shard that looks 'tombstoned' at HF origin; presign request for the S3 mirror returned 403 and our checksum differs from manifest. anyone run into HF tombstones before? @alex @priya

alex: can you paste the manifest line + the S3 key? also run `aws s3api head-object` on the bucket and show output

clara: manifest snippet:
```
\"zeta-2.0/weights/part-00023.bin\" sha256: 4b7f12e9a2c4d6f8a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890a1b2c3d4e5f67890
origin: https://huggingface.co/pubmodel/zeta-2.0/resolve/main/weights/part-00023.bin
```
head-object returned 404:
```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-artifacts --key zeta-2.0/weights/part-00023.bin
An error occurred (404) when calling the HeadObject operation: Not Found
```

ben: HF sometimes 'tombstones' objects when owners remove them; HF may still keep manifest metadata pointing to them. Could be a deleted upstream file. Do we have a previous mirror copy?

priya: fallback options: 1) use earlier mirrored snapshot if available 2) request HF repo owner to re-upload 3) fallback to quantized variant of the shard (if available) — latter buys time.

infra-bot: Notice — presign-token-rotation completed for bucket redwood-artifacts at 2024-12-12T18:05:33Z (id: rot-20241212). If presign TTL < 1h some long downloads can fail.

alex: presign TTL seems fine but HF responded 410/403 earlier? can you fetch headers from origin:
```
$ curl -I https://huggingface.co/pubmodel/zeta-2.0/resolve/main/weights/part-00023.bin
HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
...
```
if it's 410 that confirms tombstone.

clara: curl shows 410. sha256 locally is 3c9d4b7a9e2d1c6f7b8a9e2d1c6f7b8a9e2d1c6f7b8a9e2d1c6f7b8a9e2d1c6 which doesn't match manifest. I re-ran the mirror job twice; same result.

ben: create a ticket to the weights-registry team with manifest, origin headers, local checksum, and manifest checksum. tagging ops and legal if it's a takedown: @ops @legal

priya: quick experiment — try hf hub CLI `python -c "from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download; print(hf_hub_download(repo_id=\'pubmodel/zeta-2.0\', filename=\'weights/part-00023.bin\'))"` sometimes direct hf api returns a cached link.

alex: if HF won't restore, we should: (A) mark the model as \"origin-unavailable\" in registry, (B) point serving to the fallback quantized model, (C) schedule rollback for any canaries. I'll make the config changes if you open a PR.

clara: opening ticket now: https://redwood-internal/issue/INF-3429 — added logs, curl headers, manifest lines, local md5/sha256. tagging @alex @ben @priya. will also try hf_hub_download and report back.

priya: thanks — if hf_hub_download works, we can re-mirror and update provenance. if not, agree with config changes. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks, queued for config PR & canary hold. :ok_hand:

clara: noted, assigning follow-ups in ticket. will update thread when I have hf_hub_download result.
